focus: RQ-1, RQ-4, and RQ-5: reader inventory, hub-root projection, measured savings, and baseline conflicts
answeredQuestions: RQ-1: Which scripts, tests, generators, runtime adapters and other tools read a SKILL.md MACHINE ROUTER section or its markers, and what sibling ROUTER.md change does each require?
RQ-4: How can a hub MACHINE ROUTER join its existing root ROUTER.md without changing the router replay mode projection?
RQ-5: What migration preserves advisor accuracy 155/195, 49/66 and 19/24, router replay and compiled-route hashes while measuring token savings per skill and tracking debt?

label: Direct readers are the replay parser, router-sync check, dead-resource-path scanner, and two routing-shape validators; the skill-creation template and Hermes mirror are migration producers, while the measurement harness only extracts SMART ROUTING.

The seven runtime surfaces discover or copy SKILL.md through distinct paths, and none automatically adds an arbitrary sibling ROUTER.md to model context; a short pointer in SKILL.md must direct an on-demand read.

The agent needs the route decision rule, resource destinations, load levels, and ambiguity fallback; scripts need literal assignment grammar, delimiters, and path-resolution rules, so keep the decision rule in the short skill prose and use the sidecar as the detailed source.

Seven hubs already have root ROUTER.md files, and their moved MACHINE ROUTER sections contain no INTENT_SIGNALS, INTENT_MODEL, RESOURCE_MAP, or DEFAULT_RESOURCE assignment rows; merge the hub instructions into a separate named section and retain the existing stage-two map as the sole projection source.

The current package validator, doctor check, smart-router template, and parent creation workflow forbid a mode packet's own ROUTER.md, so RS-004 and the authoring contract must be revised before the requested sibling-file migration can pass.

The current tree has 57 SKILL.md files and 54 router sections totaling 39,159 words and 89,931 local O200K-export tokens; a standardized 23-token pointer leaves 88,689 initial-load token units, with exact gpt-6-luna counts unverified.

Exact compiled hash preservation conflicts with the current byte-provenance contract: moved text changes SKILL.md or ROUTER.md source hashes, which feed effectivePolicyHash and projectionHash; the accuracy dataset behind 155/195, 49/66, and 19/24 also needs a frozen fixture before parity can be proven.
